description: This module allows users to read, write, and delete macOS user defaults from Ansible scripts.

parameters.name: array_add
parameters.description: Add new elements to the array for a key which has an array as its value. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: check_type
parameters.description: Checks if the type of the provided value matches the type of an existing default. If the types do not match, raises an error. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: dict_mode
parameters.description: Defines the write behavior for type=dict values. replace writes the full dictionary, replacing any existing value. add merges only the specified keys into the existing dictionary, leaving other keys untouched. Choices: "replace" ← (default) "add"

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain is a domain name of the form com.companyname.appname. Default: "NSGlobalDomain"

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The host on which the preference should apply. The special value currentHost corresponds to the -currentHost switch of the defaults commandline tool.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key of the user preference.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path in which to search for defaults. Default: "/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the user defaults. If set to list it queries the given parameter specified by key. Returns null is nothing found or misspelled. Choices: "absent" "list" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of value to write. dict has been added in community.general 12.5.0. Choices: "array" "bool" "boolean" "date" "dict" "float" "int" "integer" "string" ← (default)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to write. Only required when state=present.

examples:
- name: Set boolean valued key for application domain
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    domain: com.apple.Safari
    key: IncludeInternalDebugMenu
    type: bool
    value: true
    state: present

- name: Set string valued key for global domain
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    domain: NSGlobalDomain
    key: AppleMeasurementUnits
    type: string
    value: Centimeters
    state: present

- name: Set int valued key for arbitrary plist
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    domain: /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate
    key: AutomaticCheckEnabled
    type: int
    value: 1
  become: true

- name: Set int valued key only for the current host
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    domain: com.apple.screensaver
    host: currentHost
    key: showClock
    type: int
    value: 1

- name: Defaults to global domain and setting value
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    key: AppleMeasurementUnits
    type: string
    value: Centimeters

- name: Setting an array valued key
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    key: AppleLanguages
    type: array
    value:
      - en
      - nl

- name: Setting a dict valued key
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    domain: com.apple.finder
    key: FXInfoPanesExpanded
    type: dict
    value:
      General: true
      OpenWith: true
      Privileges: true

- name: Removing a key
  community.general.osx_defaults:
    domain: com.geekchimp.macable
    key: ExampleKeyToRemove
    state: absent
